title: List overview and access
summary: Identify a list, read active items, understand unavailable access and continue on web or Android.

roles.meaning: Native action to continue with this list.

states.meaning: The accessible list has no active items.
The web is waiting for initial list data.
The widget has no saved snapshot to display.
The selected list cannot be accessed.
A refresh or mutation failed without proving loss of access.

rules.behaviour: Show the list identity when content is accessible.
Distinguish active items from completed items and respect native ordering.
Replace inaccessible list content with an unavailable message.
Offer native continuation appropriate to the accessible list; the widget opens the selected web list rather than editing it.
Retain the last-success time on transient widget failure; never describe cached content as a successful current refresh.
Expose meaningful reading and action labels and verify native keyboard or TalkBack use.

exclusions: Unconfigured is a widget state; web instead offers list creation/selection.
gaps: Drag-handle focus and screen-reader use need native assistive-technology review.
Browser keyboard checks cover detail and completion; they do not establish full accessibility conformance.

exclusions: Read-only snapshot; no item completion, editing, web grouping or completed-item view.
No separate loading presentation: missing snapshot uses choose-list copy.
No separate transient-error banner or inline retry in message states.
gaps: TalkBack, launcher interaction and reading order not yet verified.
Encrypted on-device persistence and real PWA launch remain device checks; JVM tests cover state transitions and action targets.
